account.affected_resources: Would require every owned domain and identity/provider/copy lifecycle
account.retained_metadata: Existing owner and all formal references remain
account.backup_effect: Full primary-loss/public erasure acceptance blocked R-09
account.ui_api_limit: No App claim of complete personal-data deletion

person.affected_resources: Existing multiple Relationships, speaker bindings, Memory and provenance FKs
person.backup_effect: Retained by local restore; future explicit lifecycle task
person.ui_api_limit: No DELETE endpoint/button; no widened cascade

relationship.affected_resources: Conversation, Dataset and Memory references must be independently specified
relationship.backup_effect: Retained by local restore; future explicit lifecycle task

conversation.self_service: Backend-only guarded API; no App self-service
conversation.confirmation: Five-minute server snapshot challenge; explicit execute and operation key
conversation.affected_resources: Exact Conversation and all its formal Messages, across roles; associated run body metadata
conversation.primary_rows: Messages physically removed; warnings/memory_status scrubbed; Conversation tombstoned
conversation.retained_metadata: Conversation scope UUID; Run ID/status/key/fingerprint/error code; counts and timestamps; immutable erasure receipt
conversation.memory_effect: Existing Memory/consent/undo retained; run references may remain
conversation.backup_effect: Frozen current primary exact tombstone/key/receipt reconciliation; missing authoritative target/key/receipt denies release
conversation.ui_api_limit: Old history/REST/SSE 404, create old UUID 409; pending/running/unresolved Memory run blocks; cached clients must refresh

agent_history.self_service: Backend-only via containing Conversation; no per-message/run erasure
agent_history.affected_resources: All Messages in exact Conversation; Run links SET NULL and outcome metadata scrubbed
agent_history.primary_rows: No message body remains; run dedup metadata retained
agent_history.retained_metadata: Run operation keys/status/fingerprint and Conversation tombstone protect replay
agent_history.backup_effect: Same Conversation/key reconciliation; post-backup keys cannot be omitted
agent_history.ui_api_limit: No standalone Agent history DELETE; old run key cannot recreate answer

dataset.self_service: Backend-only guarded API; no App self-service
dataset.authorized_actor: Signed canonical imported Job owner and exact Relationship
dataset.affected_resources: All RelationshipMessages and speaker labels in exact canonical Job
dataset.primary_rows: Formal RelationshipMessages/speakers physically removed; imported canonical Job tombstoned
dataset.retained_metadata: Job UUID/scope/fingerprint/import counts/times and durable erasure receipt; no message/speaker body
dataset.import_dedup: Imported status and partial unique scope index retained; original/duplicate/new identical finalize rejected
dataset.backup_effect: Current primary exact target/scope/receipt required; old backup must already contain canonical imported fence or release fails closed
dataset.ui_api_limit: No Job UUID reuse; other transcripts/owners/Relationships remain independent; inspect metadata is historical receipt

relationship_message.self_service: Backend-only through containing Dataset; no per-message erasure
relationship_message.retained_metadata: No raw speaker label/content; Dataset receipt and dedup fences retained
relationship_message.memory_effect: Independent of Memory and Agent chat
relationship_message.backup_effect: Dataset reconciliation removes restored rows; no arbitrary hash-wide deletion
relationship_message.ui_api_limit: History list and old cursor filter tombstone; cached client must refresh

memory.self_service: Existing separate guarded Memory control, including App controls
memory.confirmation: Existing server challenge and immutable guarded receipt
memory.primary_rows: Existing Phase6/9D guarded erasure and bounded retention semantics
memory.retained_metadata: Existing control/version/receipt minimum; undo handling unchanged
memory.memory_effect: Only selected Memory; chat/import histories retained
memory.backup_effect: Existing 9D exact authority reconciliation and challenge invalidation retained
memory.ui_api_limit: Memory deletion is not Conversation, Dataset, Person, Relationship or account erasure
